description: Sud-Ouest : Canalisations TMD - TEREGA (ex TIGF) - Mesures compensatoires MC4 (linéaire) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Access to data is restricted to authorised persons. This dataset contains the linear lines of compensatory measures 4 (MC4) related to the transport pipelines of natural gas, hydrocarbons and chemicals of the Terega carrier, provided to DREAL pursuant to Article R554-48 of the Environmental Code and Article 16 of the Order of 5 March 2014. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "South-West: TDG Lines — Terega (ex TIGF) — Countervailing Measures MC4 (linear)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
